name: REAPER
note: REAPER has no single shortcut appendix in the current user guide: the guide points at Help > Keybindings and Mouse Modifiers (Shift+F1), which generates the list from the running program. The list here is every keyboard row of the official Cockos-hosted "REAPER Default Keyboard Shortcuts Summary: Main Section" PDF, whose printed version is v2.42; every one of its rows that the current REAPER User Guide v7.79 (reaper.fm) also prints was checked against it and they agree (the track-height keys ` ~ ! @, the +/- and Page Up/Down zoom keys, Ctrl+Page Up / Ctrl+Page Down, the marker keys 1-0 and Ctrl+1-0 and ] [, Ctrl+J, Shift+F1, Shift+E, F2, Alt+arrow scrolling, Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down track navigation, the time selection nudge keys , . and their Ctrl/Shift forms, Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+Delete, Alt+X, Alt+P, Shift+R, M and Shift+M), so shortcuts that the current guide does not mention may still be older. "Split item(s) at prior zero crossing" (Alt+Z) is taken from the v7.79 guide. The context is the summary's own heading, lightly shortened. REAPER's shortcuts are documented for Windows; the user guide states that macOS users substitute Cmd for Ctrl and Opt for Alt, which is how the mac column here was derived. The summary prints the shifted characters ! @ ~ ? and " as keys; the v7.79 user guide spells out that these are Shift plus 1, 2, ` (and, by the same US layout, / and '), so they are written here as Shift+1, Shift+2, Shift+`, Shift+/ and Shift+'. Where a row lists alternatives ("+ or =", "W or Home", "Ctrl+Space or Enter", "Num 2 or Ctrl+Down") the first form the grammar can express is kept. Rows that name a numbered set ("Marker, go to marker number - 1 thru 9") are split into one action per key with the key in parentheses. Left out: every numpad row (Move items left/right/up/down, Move contents of items, Grow/Shrink item edges, Move notes one octave), every mouse-modifier table (item movement, item edge, fades, marquee selection, track faders, mute/solo buttons, mousewheel zoom and scroll, envelope editing, the Mixer/Routing Matrix/Navigator/Performance Meter/FX browser click tables), and the "Cursor, go to" row whose key the PDF does not print legibly. The summary lists "Load Track View #03" and "Save Track View #03" twice each (an apparent typo for #02); both rows are kept with the key added in parentheses to tell them apart.
